major_cooldowns.name: Takedown
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Survival's primary cooldown: 20% damage and doubled auto-attack speed for only 8 sec, so enter it prepared, with 2 Tip of the Spear stacks from a Kill Command pressed right before it, or with 0 stacks if you run Twin Fangs, and press it again as a filler whenever it drifts off cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 1250646, base cooldown 90s per the ability table; the guide notes 2 points of Savagery cut it to 60s.

major_cooldowns.name: Boomstick
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown with Tip of the Spear up, and on Sentinel only while the target has no Sentinel's Mark; with Lethal Calibration each Wildfire Bomb hit shaves 2 sec off it, up to 10 sec.

major_cooldowns.name: Flamefang Pitch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown in both single target and AoE; it does not need to be Tipped, so never spend a Tip of the Spear stack setting it up.

major_cooldowns.name: Moonlight Chakram
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On Sentinel it replaces the Takedown button for 15 sec after Takedown is pressed: throw it with Tip of the Spear up, early in the window, and never let it expire unused.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Sentinel-only button, not observed in the sampled Pack Leader parse; 1264949 is the castable 40 yd row, while the guide links the talent node 1264902. Cooldown is once per Takedown, so it is tracked at Takedown's 90s.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it about 2 sec before the pull, 3 sec if you are also pre-casting a bomb, and afterwards only fire it when Takedown is within 5 sec of coming up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket; zero casts is expected for any player not wearing it.

rule.description: Tip of the Spear stays up between Kill Commands
rule.action: Every ability should be Tipped. Run Kill Command into 2 Tipped abilities and repeat, and press Kill Command whenever you are down to 1 stack or fewer so the buff never sits empty.

rule.description: Boomstick only with Tip of the Spear up
rule.action: Press Kill Command before Boomstick so the 3 sec channel is Tipped; on Sentinel also wait until Sentinel's Mark has fallen off the target.

rule.description: Takedown spent at max Tip of the Spear stacks
rule.action: Enter Takedown with 2 Tip of the Spear stacks, pressing Kill Command right before it to set them up without overcapping (0 stacks if you run Twin Fangs).

rule.description: Open Kill Command into Takedown, then Boomstick
rule.action: Pre-cast Wildfire Bomb about 1 sec before the pull, then Kill Command, potion and racials, Takedown, Wildfire Bomb, Kill Command, Boomstick, Kill Command. In AoE hold Takedown until the pack is stacked.

rule.description: Algeth'ar Puzzle Box lines up with Takedown
rule.action: Fire the trinket only when Takedown is ready or within 5 sec of coming up, and pre-cast it roughly 2 sec before the pull so its 20 sec of Mastery covers the opener window.
